lines.text: Did you know that nobody… not your parents, not your teachers, not even superheroes… can stop kids from scrolling? <break time="1.0s" /> So I had a crazy idea. What if we didn't stop you… what if we made your scrolling… smart?

Let's climb the Screen-Time Tower! <break time="0.6s" /> Scientists in America asked thousands of families how long kids spend on screens, just for fun. <break time="0.8s" /> Floor one: ages two to four. About two and a half hours a day! <break time="0.8s" /> Floor two: ages five to eight. More than three hours! <break time="0.8s" /> Floor three: ages eight to twelve. Hold on tight… five and a half hours. Every. Single. Day. <break time="0.8s" /> And the top floor, teenagers? Almost nine hours! That's longer than a whole school day!

So where do all those hours go? <break time="0.5s" /> Into Endless Video Land… where videos and games start the next one automatically. There's never a moment to stop! <break time="0.8s" /> That's not an accident. It's a trick… and he is behind it. <break time="0.6s" /> The Scroll Monster!

Boss fight! The Scroll Monster is sneaky. <break time="0.5s" /> He steals dinner… “just one more video”. <break time="0.7s" /> He steals sleep. Kids your age need nine to twelve hours, and screens at bedtime keep your brain buzzing. <break time="0.7s" /> And he steals friends. Real ones, the kind you play football with! <break time="0.8s" /> Doctors and the World Health Organization say little kids, aged two to five, should have no more than one hour of screens a day. <break time="0.6s" /> Yoink! Daxter wins the treasures back!

Professor Hoot flies in with a glowing map: the Road of Wonders! <break time="0.6s" /> Here's my deal. In Did You Know That, you still scroll… but every story teaches you something real. <break time="0.7s" /> Read the magic book, watch the story, answer Professor Hoot, and win Special Cards. Collect them, earn points, and climb the leaderboard! <break time="0.8s" /> And the best part? The game lets you watch only three videos a day. Then it says: go eat, go sleep, go play with your friends. I'll wait for you tomorrow!

Level complete! <break time="0.6s" /> Your mission: open the game, find my house, type the secret word, and win your very first card… the Scroll Tamer! <break time="0.8s" /> Did you know that? Now you do. See you on the Road of Wonders!
